title: 1970 Topps - #31 Dave Grayson Raiders
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1970 Topps sports trading card features Dave Grayson of the Oakland Raiders, card number 31. It's a great addition to any collection for fans of football and the National Football League (NFL). The card is from the base set and was manufactured by Topps. 

In addition to being a valuable trading card, this piece is also a piece of history from the 1970 season. It's a must-have for any true football fan or collector of sports memorabilia. Add it to your collection today and own a piece of NFL history.
